question.text: MIIs and custodians are advised to extend the T+0 settlement facility to which category of investors?

explanation.text: The Logic: MIIs and custodians are advised to extend the T+0 settlement facility to institutional investors as well. The Trap: Restricting the advised extension to retail, HNI, or foreign investors does not match the wording on the controlling page, which identifies institutional investors. Note: The Series VII workbook (p.178) is the controlling source for this advisory to MIIs and custodians to extend the T+0 settlement facility to institutional investors.
